Step:  
Start: 1573-08-23  
Subtract 6 months: 1573-02-23  
Subtract 27 days:  
February 1573 had 28 days (not leap year in Gregorian, but 1573 not divisible by 4).  
From Feb 23 back 27 days:  
Feb 23 → Feb 1 is 22 days back, need 5 more days back into January.  
So Jan 31, 30, 29, 28, 27 → 1573-01-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1573-01-27
